item.title: Parking issue is big problem here no parking for people and people park everywhere because of this reason, 1st September
item.description:
There is a lack of adequate parking available for customers visiting local businesses in this area. This has been an ongoing issue for several months and is negatively impacting footfall, as customers struggle to find nearby parking and often choose to go elsewhere. Existing spaces are either too limited or frequently occupied for long periods, making short visits difficult. Increasing parking availability or introducing better parking management (e.g. time limits or designated customer bays) would significantly support local businesses and improve access for visitors.
Report on FixMyStreet

Two other trees on this road have fallen on cars in recent years during strong winds and this one has potential to do the same as cars regularly park underneath.
